purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The city TaxParcel service contains both Parcel and Condo Unit feature rows. The qualified source scope uses the publisher’s RECORDTYPE=Parcel filter and OBJECTID as the unique native row identity; PARCELID is retained only as a non-unique label. A 13-cell run passed forced three-row paging (26 source rows over nine pages), fresh geometry reads for all 46 IDs, explicit absence, footprint, and binding checks. All 46 filtered geometries passed independent EPSG:32617 GEOS validity/duplicate/overlap checks. The ranked WUP point is covered by ground parcel OBJECTID 97983. This is a city tax-parcel layer, not a title determination or citywide completeness claim.
registryAssessment: The City of Fort Lauderdale’s TaxParcel MapServer publishes real-property polygon areas combined with city assessing and tax-system data. This confirms a municipal tax-parcel layer, not legal title or a cadastral survey.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official City of Fort Lauderdale map service describes published real-property areas combined with assessment and tax information; notes possible redundant condo geometry.
Official polygon feature layer; supports JSON/GeoJSON. A bounded WUP-point query returned one polygon using OBJECTID/PARCELID only.

scope: 46 valid, distinct Fort Lauderdale ground Parcel records verified in thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged ranked WUP locator. The publisher-defined RECORDTYPE=Parcel filter excludes redundant Condo Unit rows and is enforced on every query. OBJECTID is the unique service row identity; PARCELID is a non-unique display label. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging (26 rows over nine pages), all 46 fresh identity reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32617 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. This is municipal tax-parcel geometry; citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and permanent service-row identity are unverified.
